description: Phase A subset for real LLM RTL patch proposal evaluation with stable target SVAs.
claim_boundary: Stable target SVA generation is deterministic/manual; patch source is real LLM only when the runner is invoked with an LLM command and explicit external-send acknowledgement.

cases.intent: The arbiter must never grant both clients in the same cycle.

stable_sva.sva: p_rtl2repair_01: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) !(gnt0 && gnt1));
stable_sva.intent_summary: The arbiter must never grant both clients in the same cycle.

cases.claim_boundary: Measures RTL patch proposal under a deterministic mutual-exclusion SVA, not SVA generation quality.

cases.intent: The buffer must keep output data stable while stalled and must not overwrite buffered data before dequeue.

stable_sva.sva: p_rtl2repair_01: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) out_valid && !out_ready |=> out_valid && $stable(out_data));
stable_sva.intent_summary: Buffered output data should remain stable while stalled.

cases.claim_boundary: Measures RTL patch proposal under a deterministic stalled-data stability SVA.

cases.intent: APB writes must update only the register selected by paddr.

stable_sva.sva: p_rtl2repair_01: assert property (@(posedge pclk) disable iff (!presetn) psel && penable && pwrite && pready && paddr == 8'h00 |=> reg0 == $past(pwdata));
stable_sva.intent_summary: Writes to address 0x00 should update reg0.

cases.claim_boundary: Measures RTL patch proposal under a deterministic APB address-select SVA.
